title: Foldable Phones Finally Reach Mainstream Pricing
summary: Cheaper hinges and panels bring foldables under the flagship line.

body.text: Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
The hard part was never the technology, it was the coordination.
The findings were published this week after an extended peer review process.
Long term, the impact will depend on adoption by the wider industry.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
